clean.root_cause: The agent never located the potato because it wandered through irrelevant locations without systematically searching containers (cabinets, fridge) and then stopped after moving an irrelevant pot.
clean.evidence: After moving pot2, it returns to countertop1 -> countertop2 -> countertop3 and halts, never having taken or cleaned a potato.
clean.corrective_rule: Before cleaning, systematically search all common storage locations (cabinets, fridge, sinkbasin) for the target object.
clean.skill_tree_gap: Missing a dedicated 'find object' subroutine that exhaustively checks containers.
clean.patch_location: New subsection '### search for target object' under '## clean'

cool.root_cause: The agent never found an apple because it explored many locations but did not open any cabinets or drawers where the apple might be, and gave up after opening the fridge (which had no apple).
cool.evidence: After opening fridge (no apple), it returns to countertop1 and stops, without ever taking an apple or attempting to cool anything.
cool.corrective_rule: Always open containers (cabinets, drawers) when searching for a target object; do not rely on open surfaces alone.
cool.skill_tree_gap: Lack of a systematic container-opening step in the exploration routine.
cool.patch_location: New subsection '### search for target object' under '## cool'

cool.root_cause: The agent never took an apple because it did not open any containers (fridge, cabinets) and instead wandered through irrelevant locations before returning to countertop2.
cool.evidence: After going to fridge1 and not opening it, it goes back to countertop1 then countertop2, never having picked up an apple.
cool.corrective_rule: Always open containers (especially the fridge) when searching for a target object that can be cooled.
cool.skill_tree_gap: Missing exploration step that includes opening containers.
cool.patch_location: New subsection '### search for target object' under '## cool'

cool.root_cause: The agent never found a mug because it skipped the initial consensus location and then only opened cabinet4 (empty) while ignoring other containers like drawers and other cabinets.
cool.evidence: After opening cabinet4 (nothing), it goes to countertop1 and stops, never having taken a mug.
cool.corrective_rule: Systematically search all cabinets, drawers, and shelves for the target object before concluding it is absent.
cool.skill_tree_gap: Lack of exhaustive container search strategy.
cool.patch_location: New subsection '### search for target object' under '## cool'

look_at_obj_in_light.root_cause: The agent never located a watch because it only opened drawer1 (empty) and then attempted an invalid action (taking pencil from a different shelf) instead of searching all containers for the watch.
look_at_obj_in_light.evidence: After opening drawer1 (empty), it explores shelves but never finds a watch; last action 'take pencil 1 from shelf 2' is invalid (wrong location).
look_at_obj_in_light.corrective_rule: First, systematically search all containers (drawers, shelves, cabinets) for the target object; second, ensure any take action is from the current location.
look_at_obj_in_light.skill_tree_gap: Missing container search routine and action precondition checking.
look_at_obj_in_light.patch_location: New subsection '### search for target object' under '## look_at_obj_in_light'

pick_and_place.root_cause: The agent never found a spraybottle because it only opened two cabinets (both containing cloth) and did not search other cabinets (e.g., cabinet3, cabinet4) or the countertop where the spraybottle might be.
pick_and_place.evidence: After opening cabinet2 (cloth2), it returns to countertop1 and shelf1 without ever taking a spraybottle.
pick_and_place.corrective_rule: Exhaustively open all cabinets and search all countertops for the target object before moving to irrelevant actions.
pick_and_place.skill_tree_gap: Missing exhaustive container search in the pick-and-place routine.
pick_and_place.patch_location: New subsection '### search for target object' under '## pick_and_place'

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: The agent stopped after taking only one remotecontrol, failing to find a second one and to place any remotecontrol in the armchair.
pick_two_obj_and_place.evidence: The trajectory ends immediately after 'take remotecontrol 4 from coffeetable 1' with no further actions.
pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: Continue searching for the second target object and then place both; do not stop after collecting only one.
pick_two_obj_and_place.skill_tree_gap: Missing a loop or counter to ensure exactly two objects are collected and placed.
pick_two_obj_and_place.patch_location: New subsection '### ensure correct count of objects' under '## pick_two_obj_and_place'

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: The agent took a soapbottle (soapbottle2) instead of a soapbar, and then placed it in the cabinet, completely missing the required object type.
pick_two_obj_and_place.evidence: Action 'take soapbottle 2 from countertop 1' followed by 'move soapbottle 2 to cabinet 1'.
pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: Before taking an object, verify that its type matches the target (soapbar, not soapbottle).
pick_two_obj_and_place.skill_tree_gap: Missing object type verification step before picking up.
pick_two_obj_and_place.patch_location: New subsection '### verify object type before pick' under '## pick_two_obj_and_place'

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: The agent took soapbars (soapbar3 and soapbar2) instead of soapbottles, and placed them on the countertop, fulfilling the wrong object type.
pick_two_obj_and_place.evidence: Actions 'take soapbar 3 from bathtubbasin 1' and 'take soapbar 2 from countertop 1' then moved them to countertop1.
pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: Before taking, confirm the object is the required type (soapbottle, not soapbar).
